name: Kizaki Sena
source:
Haruki and Sae's second eldest daughter. She's a senior in high school like her elder sister [url=http://vndb.org/c9420]Ayame[/url] and a cheerleader at school. A troublesome girl, she's embarrassingly loving to her father at school so much so that people think she's having an incestuous affair with him even when she's not.

Although she loves her father very much she doesn't want to have sex with him. She sometimes walks around the house naked in front of him though.
